extracted.intended_audience: reporters and other members of the media who want to receive NOAA news releases electronically
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for members of the press to register to receive NOAA news releases electronically via an online media registration form. Includes an eligibility note and an email-deliverability instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose — receive NOAA news releases electronically
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporters who wish to electronically receive news releases from NOAA should fill out our online media registration form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page's stated purpose is to sign up reporters to receive NOAA news releases electronically; registration is the mechanism to receive those communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — members of the media only
rubrics_metrics.description: This option is for members of the media only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only credentialed or self-identified members of the press should use the media registration form; non-media users should not register using this form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration method — complete the online media registration form (offsite link)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporters ... should fill out our online media registration form (offsite link).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The registration is completed via an external/offsitely hosted form linked from the page. Follow the provided link to submit required registration information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email deliverability — set filters to allow noaa@meltwater.com
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE: Please make sure your e-mail filters are set to receive e-mail from noaa@meltwater.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To ensure NOAA news releases are delivered to your inbox, add noaa@meltwater.com to allowed/safe-sender lists or adjust spam filters accordingly.
